title: Director - Process & Quality - ServiceNow
jobDescription:
Job Title: Director – Process & Quality

Location: India (Remote)
Reports To: India Head

Why Us

New Rocket is the AI-first Elite Service Now Partner that activates real value on the Now Platform. As a trusted advisor to enterprise leaders, we combine industry expertise, human-centered design, and enterprise-grade AI to help organizations navigate change and scale with confidence. With two decades of experience guiding clients to realize the full potential of the Service Now AI Platform, we are one of the largest pure-play Service Now partners, uniquely focused on enabling enterprises to adopt AI they trust—AI that delivers lasting business value.

We #Go Beyond Workflows to create new kinds of experiences for our customers.

Come join our Crew!

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director – Process & Quality with a strong background in Service Now implementations and IT Consulting. This leadership role will be responsible for establishing, governing, and continuously improving delivery processes, quality frameworks, and operational excellence across Service Now and consulting engagements.

What you will be doing

  1. Process Governance & Standardization
  • Define, implement, and continuously improve enterprise-wide delivery processes aligned with Service Now best practices.
  • Establish standardized frameworks for implementation, enhancement, AMS, and transformation programs.
  1. Quality Management & Assurance
  • Design and lead Quality Management Systems (QMS) across all delivery functions.
  • Define KPIs, SLAs, CSAT metrics, defect metrics, and quality benchmarks.
  • Conduct delivery audits, compliance checks, and quality reviews across projects.
  • Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive action frameworks.
  1. Service Now Delivery Excellence
  • Ensure adherence to Service Now implementation standards and architecture guidelines.
  • Improve implementation maturity across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, and other Service Now modules.
  • Collaborate with Practice Leads to enhance solution quality and reduce rework.
  • Govern release management, testing frameworks, and deployment quality.
  1. Consulting & Client Governance
  • Partner with client stakeholders to ensure delivery quality and governance transparency.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across client accounts.
  1. Risk, Compliance & Continuous Improvement
  • Implement automation in quality monitoring and reporting.
  1. Leadership & Capability Development
  • Build and mentor Process and Quality teams.
  • Drive training initiatives on Service Now best practices and consulting methodologies.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, structured delivery, and continuous improvement.

What you bring Along

  • 12–18+ years of experience in IT Services/Consulting.
  • 5+ years in leadership roles managing Process, Quality, or Delivery Excellence.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Service Now implementation programs.
  • Background in Consulting firms or IT Services organizations.
  • Deep understanding of ITIL, Agile, Dev Ops, and structured delivery frameworks.
  • Experience managing enterprise-scale Service Now programs.
  • Proven track record of improving delivery metrics and customer satisfaction.
  • Experience with quality frameworks such as ISO, CMMI (preferred).

Preferred Certifications

  • Service Now Certifications (CSA, CIS, CAD or equivalent)
  • ITIL Certification
  • Lean Six Sigma / Quality Certification (preferred)
  • Agile / SAFe certification (preferred)

We Take Care of Our People

New Rocket is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity, respect individuality, and ensure every employee’s voice is heard. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and affirmative action employer.

title: Product Manager (Agentic AI)
jobDescription:
Job Title: Agentic AI Product Manager
Location: India
Reports to: Agentic AI COE Leader

Position Overview:
We are seeking a highly motivated Agentic AI Product Manager to drive the market launch and IP roadmap of our innovative AI-powered solutions collaborating with sales, marketing, consulting and development. This role will work closely with the Agentic AI COE Leader to transform cutting-edge technologies—including autonomous agents, LLMs, and multi-agent systems—into scalable, customer-centric products integrated with platforms like Service Now.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in AI product lifecycle management, cross-functional collaboration, and aligning technology capabilities with business goals.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Strategy & Market Analysis

- Understand competitive market intelligence and conduct research to inform our AI roadmap and features while ensuring product/market fit.

- Define product requirements and roadmaps in partnership with the Agentic AI COE Leader and cross-functional teams that results in customer impact (cost reduction, time savings, strategic differentiation, etc.)

- Support the COE Leader in assessing AI innovation opportunities across industries. And translate strategic AI innovation goals into tangible product development initiatives.

- Identify use cases where agentic AI can enhance and/or orchestrate enterprise workflows, particularly on Service Now.

- Develop ROI models and frameworks for realizing value of our AI offerings and solutions

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Collaborate with sales, solution consulting, design, engineering, data science, and Service Now platform teams to deliver high-impact AI capabilities and IP

- Work closely with client-facing teams to identify POC’s opportunities, prioritize features, gather feedback and ensure adoption (i.e. production rollout) success.

- Work with our engineering teams to facilitate the agile development processes, define epics, elaborate user stories, translate and prioritize backlog and conduct retrospectives

AI IP Development

- Manage product lifecycle from ideation to launch, with a strong emphasis on usability, performance, ROI and business outcomes.

- Ensure products integrate seamlessly with Service Now (e.g., ITSM, HRSD, Sec Ops).

- Oversee feature validation, testing, and iteration using agile methods and customer feedback.

Market Awareness & Launch

- Stay informed on emerging trends in agentic AI, LLMs, multi-agent systems, and enterprise automation.

- Evaluate and prioritize experimental ideas, proof-of-concepts, and beta features with our clients and partners.

- Participate and orchestrate market awareness events like webinars, client roundtables, analyst presentations, partner briefings, etc.

- Assist in developing product marketing collateral such as data sheets, product positioning, FAQ’s, sales enablement, etc.

- Ensure product success in market measured by IP and services revenue from AI products and the number of production go-lives

QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field.

- 9+ years of experience in product management with a focus on AI, machine learning, or enterprise software.

- 7+ years of experience in a consulting or a product company.

- Experience integrating AI solutions into platforms like Service Now or similar enterprise systems.

- Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts including LLMs, autonomous agents, and NLP.

- Experience with AI cloud services from AWS, Google GCP, Azure, etc.

- Experience in launching enterprise AI solutions with exposure to AI governance, ethics, responsibility, etc.

- Experience working in services or consulting environments preferred specifically with AI

Preferred Skills:

- Familiarity with Service Now’s AI features (e.g., Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence).

- Data Science and Python experience

- Understanding of MLOps lifecycle and human-in-the-loop design.

- Strong storytelling, prioritization, and stakeholder communication skills.

- Industry knowledge in sectors such as BFSI and Telecom, is a plus.

  • As a Service Now Solution Architect AI , you will interface with end-users, IT teams and key stakeholders to gather systems requirements.
  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-driven applications and workflows on the Service Now platform.
  • Integrate machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics solutions into any of the Service Now modules (ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD).
  • Manage all aspects of application development, including design, coding, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, and documenting systems.
  • Write complete programming and perform testing and debugging of applications using current programming language and techniques.
  • Design custom or product-based solutions based on Service Now applications
  • Configuring integrations between Service Now via REST/SOAP web and other applications
  • Reflect impact assessment rules within service maps and validate with technical SMEs and stakeholders
  • Participate in user acceptance testing of the resulting maps, impact rules and event management work
  • Promote your update sets and data across applicable SN environments
  • Remediate any production incidents that arise related to this scope
  • Align with existing SN technical lead for map/event work to ensure consistent approach that does not break shared patterns

What You Bring Along

  • 8+ years’ experience supporting the implementation, administration, configuration, and/or development of Service Now in 2 or more capabilities (i.e. ITSM,ITOM etc.)
  • Strong experience with Service Now AI and automation capabilities, including Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence, Performance Analytics, and Now Assist, leveraging AI-driven insights to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and optimizing Now Assist features such as AI-powered case summarization, resolution recommendations, and conversational workflows.
  • Experience with integration between Service Now and other systems/platforms using both mid servers and cloud to cloud
  • Experience working with Web Services Integration (SOAP, REST) and any bi-directional, automated integration between two systems.
  • Data Extraction Technologies (e.g. JDBC, ODBC) or ETL integrations
  • Proven experience with implementing Service Now CMDB, Discovery, Software Asset Management, ITSM, Service Catalog, and Workflows to meet business requirements
  • Experience in aspects of Service Now scripting including Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Scripted REST APIs, and Scripting.
  • Thrive in strategic planning, resource allocation, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.
  • Adapts quickly in a fast-paced environment

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML, or related field.

Certifications & Knowledge

The candidate must be willing and able to continue their education within the Service Now platform and beyond. It is expected that the candidate will be able to complete Service Now competency Certifications as well as Module Accreditations.

Preferred Certifications:

  • ITIL Foundation
  • Service Now CSA and CAD
